dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Him, he's a man of mediocre talent. His movements on stage are stiff and his singing is less in tune than Swoof's.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: His only strength is his determination. To this day, he still hasn't given up on being an actor.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: I'm a person with high standards, but I don't give up on persistent students. As long as he can still accept criticism, I'll continue to instruct him.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: After all, I can't expect everyone to be as gifted as Nilou.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Ah, that reminds me, I still have more to discuss with him regarding the lines of the new script...
